content.json:
# STAT Next - Status
Secure-by-default operational workbook for Sentinel Triage AssistanT Next. Use the tabs below to review deployment health, telemetry and versions.

parameters.name: Workspace
parameters.label: Sentinel workspace
parameters.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces' | project id, name

parameters.name: FunctionApp
parameters.label: STAT Next Function
parameters.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites' | where kind has 'functionapp' | where name startswith 'statnext' or tags['ProjectName'] =~ 'STATNext' | project id, name

content.json:
## STAT Next deployment
Current Azure resources discovered for the STAT Next Function, managed identity, hosting plan, storage and Application Insights.

content.query:
resources
| where id == '{FunctionApp}'
| extend FunctionName=name, FunctionState=tostring(properties.state), FunctionLocation=location, PrincipalId=tostring(identity.principalId), PlanId=tostring(properties.serverFarmId)
| project FunctionName, FunctionState, FunctionLocation, PrincipalId, PlanId

resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.web/sites','microsoft.web/serverfarms','microsoft.storage/storageaccounts','microsoft.insights/components','microsoft.managedidentity/userassignedidentities')
| where name startswith 'statnext'
| project Resource=name, Type=type, Location=location, ResourceGroup=resourceGroup

content.json:
## Function health and telemetry
Application Insights request success, failures and latency for the selected STAT Next Function.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Requests=count(), Successful=countif(success == true), Failed=countif(success == false), AvgDurationMs=round(avg(duration / 1ms),2) by bin(timestamp, 15m)
| order by timestamp asc

exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Failures=count() by problemId, outerMessage
| top 20 by Failures desc

content.json:
## Sentinel activity
Recent Sentinel incidents in the selected workspace. This view is read-only.

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Incidents=count(), High=countif(Severity =~ 'High'), Medium=countif(Severity =~ 'Medium'), Low=countif(Severity =~ 'Low') by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

content.json:
## STAT Next version
STAT Next replaces the legacy custom connector/Logic App module version model with a single Function application package and infrastructure deployment.

content.query:
resources
| where id == '{FunctionApp}'
| project Component='STAT Next Function', Resource=name, Runtime=tostring(properties.siteConfig.linuxFxVersion), State=tostring(properties.state), Location=location
